_comment: One entry per curated real site. Run `npm run build:dem -- <id>` once; the output in public/sites/ is committed so the game never fetches tiles at runtime. Source: USGS 3DEP 1/3 arc-second DEM (prd-tnm.s3.amazonaws.com StagedProducts).
_comment_roads: Roads: add "roadsState" (NTD state file name, e.g. Colorado) and run `npm run build:roads -- <id>` once; output public/sites/<id>.roads.json is committed. Source: USGS National Transportation Dataset (prd-tnm.s3.amazonaws.com StagedProducts/Tran/Shape).
